hooks.name: Scan and validate fixtures on save
hooks.description: Runs the secret/account-ID scan and sample validation whenever a fixture or sample file is saved. Deterministic scripts only, no agent calls.

action.command: COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 corepack pnpm run scan:secrets && COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 corepack pnpm run fixtures:validate
